name: Bentley 8 Litre Saloon 1931
description:
Bentley 8 Litre, 1931: the last and largest car of W.O. Bentley's Cricklewood company, 100 built. This one is a long-chassis (156 in) four-door saloon in the Mulliner manner. 7,983 cc SOHC 4-valve six, twin SU: 220 bhp at 3,500 rpm; F-type 4-speed (3.243/1.792/1.345/1.0), right-hand change, 3.533 axle; over 100 mph. Beam axle and live axle on semi-elliptic leaves; 400 mm drums with Dewandre servo; 7.00-21 tyres; about 2,550 kg. Right-hand drive.
